scope: read-only engineering audit and sprint planning; no ML implementation

aggregate_queries.card_population: SELECT count(*) AS card_products,count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS card_customers FROM products WHERE product_type IN ('Tarjeta Crédito','Tarjeta Débito')
aggregate_queries.contact_categories: SELECT contact_reason,count(*) AS accepted_rows,count(was_resolved) AS observed_resolution_labels,count(*) FILTER(WHERE was_resolved) AS marked_resolved,count(duration_seconds) AS observed_duration FROM call_center_interactions GROUP BY contact_reason ORDER BY accepted_rows DESC
aggregate_queries.product_mention_attribution: WITH mentions AS (SELECT customer_id,trim(unnest(string_split(mentioned_products,','))) AS product_id FROM call_center_interactions WHERE mentioned_products IS NOT NULL) SELECT count(*) AS mention_tokens,count(p.product_id) AS matched_products,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.product_type IN ('Tarjeta Crédito','Tarjeta Débito')) AS matched_card_products,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.customer_id=m.customer_id) AS owner_matching_mentions,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.customer_id=m.customer_id AND p.product_type IN ('Tarjeta Crédito','Tarjeta Débito')) AS owner_matching_card_mentions FROM mentions m LEFT JOIN products p USING(product_id)

grain_note: Interaction rows are keyed by interaction_id + process_date; these are not automatically unique people or unique real incidents.
attribution_limit: Exact product-mention attribution failed ownership validation; this does not establish absence of card demand.
quality_limit: Rejection selection may bias retained-only complaint/transcript metrics. Branch relationships remain unresolved under the accepted ADR.
privacy: Aggregate results and code/release identifiers only; no customer records, credentials, private model configuration or raw transcripts included.
